title: Nukes used to bring down UFOs

tellings.quote: And yeah, Tom says that uh they've used nukes to like bring down UFOs, right?

plain: An online researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala says that the musician Tom DeLonge has claimed nuclear weapons have been used to bring down UFOs. RedPandaKoala repeats this on Jesse Michels's show as something DeLonge says, not something he saw. If true, it would mean the military has fought these objects with its strongest weapons.
